Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to correctly navigate to the NumPy GitHub repository. Instead of directly accessing the repository at https://github.com/numpy/numpy, it performed a search on Bing for "NumPy GitHub" and then clicked on a search result link. This indirect navigation approach led to multiple redundant steps and delays in reaching the target page, as evidenced by the repeated attempts to navigate and the eventual successful access only after several iterations. The error stemmed from not directly using the provided URL or efficiently clicking the correct link in the search results, leading to unnecessary looping and wasted steps.
